title: One-to-One Correspondence
qtypes: Match identical pairs; pair objects to children; identify the unpaired item. *No numerals yet.*

title: Classification (Single Property)
qtypes: Sort objects by one attribute (color, shape, size); circle the group that belongs; "which one is different?".

title: Perceptual Same/Different
qtypes: Same/different judgment on pictures; "are these the same?" Yes/No.

title: Rote Verbal Counting to 10
qtypes: Recite the count sequence 1–10 with fingers or objects. *Recognition of written numerals not yet required.*

title: Counting Small Sets (1-3)
qtypes: Subitize small sets of 1–3; touch-and-count; match sets of equal cardinality (with no numerals).

title: Shape Matching (Perceptual)
qtypes: Match shapes to identical shapes (circle-to-circle, square-to-square); no names required.

title: Perceptual Subitizing
qtypes: Instant recognition of 1–3 dots/fingers without counting.

title: Quantity Comparison
qtypes: Which group has more / fewer / same? (no numerals required; can answer by pointing).

title: Seriation (3 Objects)
qtypes: Arrange 3 objects shortest-to-tallest; identify the middle / first / last.

title: Classification (Increasing Complexity)
qtypes: Sort into two groups by two attributes combined; "which group does this belong to?".

title: Counting to 5 (Cardinality)
qtypes: Count 1–5 objects; "how many?" (still no written numerals needed — child can answer verbally or by holding up fingers).

title: Counting 6-10
qtypes: Count 6–10 objects; introduces the count-word "ten".

title: Shape Identification
qtypes: Name shapes (circle, square, triangle, rectangle). Verbal answer or pointing.

title: 2-Item Patterns
qtypes: Complete ABAB patterns with colored blocks / fruits; "what comes next?" by pointing.

title: Comparative Vocabulary
qtypes: "long / short", "heavy / light", "full / empty". Verbal or pointing.

title: Conceptual Subitizing
qtypes: Subitize arrangements of 4–6 (ten-frame-style).

title: Basic Shape Composition
qtypes: Combine two shapes to make another (e.g. two triangles = a square).

title: Numeral Recognition (1-10)
qtypes: Match the spoken/written numeral to its word; trace the numeral.

title: Numeral-Quantity Correspondence
qtypes: Match the numeral (e.g. "5") to a set of 5 objects.

title: Numeral Comparison (Object-Mediated)
qtypes: Compare two sets via a third representation (dots / fingers).

title: Seriation with Transitivity
qtypes: "If A > B and B > C, then A > C." Can be done with three sticks without numerals.

title: Flexible Classification
qtypes: Re-sort by a different attribute after the first sort; "now group them by…".

title: Numeral Sequencing
qtypes: Write the next numeral in a sequence; fill the missing number 1–10.

title: Comparative Vocabulary (Formalizing)
qtypes: Use >, <, = with objects and with numerals up to 10.

title: Patterns (2-Item Indep & 3-Item Intro)
qtypes: Continue ABAB, AAB, ABB, ABC patterns.

title: Basic Shape Properties
qtypes: Identify sides, corners, "rolls vs. slides".

title: Shape Composition & Decomposition
qtypes: Cut a square into two triangles;

title: Abstract Numeral Comparison
qtypes: Compare numerals up to 20 with `<`, `>`, `=`.

title: Close Numeral Comparison
qtypes: Compare numerals that differ by 1–2 (e.g. 18 vs 19).

title: Counting Objects to 20
qtypes: Touch-and-count 11–20 objects.

title: Reading & Writing Numerals to 99
qtypes: Write the numeral from its word ("twenty-three" → 23).

title: Tens and Ones
qtypes: Decompose 47 = 4 tens + 7 ones; place-value chart fill-in.

title: Single-Digit Addition
qtypes: Sums up to 10 (e.g. 4 + 5 = ?); vertical addition (no carry).

title: Single-Digit Subtraction
qtypes: Differences up to 10; vertical subtraction (no borrow).

title: 3D Shape Properties
qtypes: Identify cube, sphere, cylinder, cone by touch/look.

title: Non-Standard Length Estimation
qtypes: "How many pencils long is the desk?" — answer by counting units.

title: Non-Standard Capacity Estimation
qtypes: "How many cups fill the jug?" — answer by counting.

title: 3-Item Pattern Completion
qtypes: Continue ABC, AABB patterns.

title: Concept of Zero
qtypes: "How many apples are left? → 0."

title: Ordinal Positions (1st-10th)
qtypes: "Who is third in line?" — answer verbally or by pointing.

title: Informal Number Line (0-20)
qtypes: Place the missing numeral on a 0–20 number line; jump 1 forward / backward.

title: Advanced Shape Composition
qtypes: Compose/decompose 3D shapes (e.g. two cubes = a rectangular prism).

title: Reading & Writing 3-Digit Numbers
qtypes: 247 → "two hundred forty-seven"; numeral-from-word.

title: Tens as Bundles/Groups
qtypes: Base-10 blocks: 3 hundreds + 4 tens + 7 ones.

title: Flexible 2-Digit Decomposition
qtypes: 83 = 50 + 33 = 70 + 13 = … (multiple correct decompositions).

title: 2-Digit Addition with Regrouping
qtypes: Vertical addition with carry (e.g. 47 + 28).

title: 2-Digit Subtraction with Regrouping
qtypes: Vertical subtraction with borrow (e.g. 52 − 27).

title: Multiplication as Repeated Addition
qtypes: 4 × 3 = 4 + 4 + 4 = 12; array/grid representation.

title: Division as Equal Sharing
qtypes: "12 candies shared among 3 friends = ?" Picture-based.

title: Currency Recognition
qtypes: Identify ₹10 note vs ₹50 note; verbal naming.

title: Informal Fractions (Folding)
qtypes: Fold a paper into 2 / 4 equal parts; "this is half".

title: Uniform Non-Standard Measurement
qtypes: Measure a strip using paper clips (all same size).

title: 2D Shape Set Identification
qtypes: "Which of these is a quadrilateral?" Multiple shapes shown.

title: Spatial Vocabulary
qtypes: "above / below / beside / inside / outside".

title: Calendar Reading
qtypes: Read day/month from a calendar; verbal answers.

title: Data Handling (Sorting & Tallies)
qtypes: Count tally marks (groups of 5); make a tally chart.

title: Number Patterns & Sequences
qtypes: Find the rule; continue 2, 4, 6, 8, __.

title: Zero as a Placeholder
qtypes: 105 vs 15 — explain why the zero matters.

title: Extended Number Line (0-100)
qtypes: Place 73 on a 0–100 line; estimate nearest 10.

title: 3-Digit Place Value & Expanded Form
qtypes: 437 = 400 + 30 + 7; numeral from expanded form.

title: Flexible 3-Digit Decomposition
qtypes: Multiple correct decompositions of a 3-digit number.

title: 3-Digit Comparison & Ordering
qtypes: Order 4 numbers from smallest to largest.

title: Reading & Writing 4-Digit Numbers
qtypes: 4,572 → "four thousand five hundred seventy-two".

title: 3-Digit Addition & Subtraction Problems
qtypes: Word problems (e.g. "Riya has 347 marbles; she gives 158 to Aman. How many left?").

title: Full Multiplication Tables (2-10)
qtypes: Recall any single-digit multiplication.

title: Standard Measurement Units
qtypes: Convert cm ↔ m, g ↔ kg.

title: Relating 2D Faces to 3D Solids
qtypes: "A cube has how many faces?" (6).

title: Telling Time (Hours & Half-Hours)
qtypes: Read analog clock to hour / half-hour.

title: Money Arithmetic
qtypes: "₹75 − ₹28 = ?" Word-problem format.

title: Formal Fractions (Half/Quarter)
qtypes: "What fraction is shaded? 1/2, 1/4."

title: Pattern Rules & Generalization
qtypes: "The rule is ×2 +1. Find the next three terms."

title: Data Handling (Pictographs & Bar Graphs)
qtypes: Read pictograph; answer "How many more…?".

title: Large Number Operations & Regrouping
qtypes: Add/subtract 4- and 5-digit numbers vertically.

title: Complex Multi-Digit Word Problems
qtypes: Two-step word problems (e.g. "A shop sold 247 books on Monday and 158 on Tuesday. How many total? They returned 32. How many were kept?").

title: Extended Multiplication
qtypes: 2-digit × 2-digit (e.g. 47 × 28), 3-digit × 1-digit.

title: Formal Long Division
qtypes: Long division with/without remainder (e.g. 875 ÷ 5).

title: Fractional Notation & Equivalence
qtypes: "2/4 = ?/8" (equivalent fractions).

title: Standard Unit Conversion
qtypes: Convert m ↔ cm, km ↔ m, kg ↔ g.

title: Applied Measurement Word Problems
qtypes: "A rope is 3 m 45 cm long. Cut into 2 equal pieces. How long is each?"

title: 3D Nets & Spatial Perspective
qtypes: "Which net folds into a cube?"

title: Advanced Time Calculation
qtypes: "Start 9:15, end 11:45. How long?"

title: Advanced Number Patterns
qtypes: Fibonacci-style, square-number, triangular-number.

title: Bar Graphs & Data Interpretation
qtypes: Read a multi-series bar graph; compute mean.

title: Factors & Multiples
qtypes: "Find all factors of 24." "First 5 multiples of 7."

title: Decimals (Tenths & Hundredths)
qtypes: "0.7 = 7/10." Place value to hundredths.

title: Angles & Turn
qtypes: Identify right / acute / obtuse; "How many right angles in a square?" (4).

title: Symmetry & Reflection
qtypes: "Draw the line of symmetry." "Is this letter symmetrical?"

title: Perimeter & Area
qtypes: "Perimeter of a 5×3 rectangle?" (16). "Area of a 6×4 rectangle?" (24).
